spell.name: Spark Dart
spell.description: A quick arcane attack taught to anyone with enough discipline not to scorch their own sleeve.

spell.name: Minor Mend
spell.description: A modest healing charm for cuts, bruises, and desperate seconds.

spell.name: Mage Armor
spell.description: A wizardly ward that turns equations into force.

spell.name: Sleep Hex
spell.description: A soft violet sigil that drags weak minds toward magical sleep.

spell.name: Bless
spell.description: A cleric prayer that steadies allies and makes courage easier.

spell.name: Sacred Flame
spell.description: Radiant fire that punishes undead and oathbreakers.

spell.name: Hunter’s Mark
spell.description: A ranger focus that makes prey easier to track and strike.

spell.name: Shadowstep Trick
spell.description: A rogue charm that borrows one step from a nearby shadow.

spell.name: Nameward Veil
spell.description: A small whispered prayer to protect the casters name.

spell.name: Thorn Snare
spell.description: Briars erupt from the ground and hold a foe in place.

spell.name: Sun-Iron Smite
spell.description: A battle prayer learned in the Dawnhammer Hills.

spell.name: Marsh Breath
spell.description: A bubble of air and stubborn will, useful in drowned ruins.

spell.name: Glass Mirror
spell.description: A desert ward that turns a strike aside in a flash of hard light.

spell.name: Tidecall
spell.description: A coastal rite that pulls pain away like an outgoing tide.

spell.name: Umbral Banishment
spell.description: A dangerous formula that rejects undead and shadow creatures from the living world.

spell.name: Astral Seal
spell.description: A final-tier spell used to close planar breaches in the Astral Crown Citadel.

spell.name: Stone Skin
spell.description: A Dawnhammer ward that hardens skin and armor like quarried stone for a short time.

spell.name: Mirage Step
spell.description: A Blue Veil movement charm that bends heat-haze around the caster’s next few steps.

spell.name: Dune Bind
spell.description: A field formula that turns loose sand into grasping bands around a foe’s ankles.

spell.name: Glass Lance
spell.description: A hard-light spear used by Glasswind duelists to pierce wards and brittle armor.

spell.name: Prismatic Refraction
spell.description: A complex refraction spell copied from the hidden Dhanor spellbook. Incoming force splits across false images before it finds the caster.

spell.name: Oasis Equation
spell.description: An Ajuna theorem-prayer that pulls moisture, mercy, and mathematical possibility into a wounded body.

spell.name: Saltmist Veil
spell.description: A Tidebound ward that wraps the caster in stinging mist, blurring outlines and hardening wet cloth like shell.

spell.name: Harbor Chain
spell.description: Spectral harbor chains snap from the ground or deck to bind a foe in place for a few crucial breaths.

spell.name: Storm Stride
spell.description: A peak-born movement spell from Thundervale that lets the caster move in the pause between thunderbeats.

spell.name: Cloudstep Ascent
spell.description: A storm giant ascent charm adapted for mortal casters. It briefly lightens the body and steadies movement on vertical paths, stormlifts, and cloud-wet ledges.

spell.name: Thunderheart Ward
spell.description: A protective storm-ward that turns the first violence of a strike into a harmless peal of thunder.

spell.name: Fulmen Spear
spell.description: A focused lance of white-blue lightning taught by High Eyrie stormwrights and refined from giant rune geometry.

spell.name: Skyhook Mending
spell.description: A ropewalker’s recovery charm that knits torn muscle and steadies shaking limbs after a fall or climb.

spell.name: Night-Eye Veil
spell.description: A late-game underworld veil that lets the caster read shadow seams, fresh tracks, and faint heat through near-total darkness.

spell.name: Spore Communion
spell.description: The caster breathes a controlled spore pattern and can receive memories from prepared fungal circles without surrendering identity.

spell.name: Shadowglass Ward
spell.description: A dark reflective ward that turns necrotic and shadow-force aside while revealing the outline of the attacker.

spell.name: Echo Step
spell.description: The caster moves between two matching echoes, escaping a bad angle or crossing a short cavern gap without disturbing loose stone.

spell.name: Black Lantern Flare
spell.description: A cold flare of revealing light that burns shadow-bound enemies and exposes invisible writing or false walls.

spell.name: Seal Mending
spell.description: Repairs torn flesh by briefly aligning it with an unbroken version of itself.

spell.name: Crownward Aegis
spell.description: Raises a ward against dominion magic, necromantic command, and planar pressure.

spell.name: Astral Banishment
spell.description: Strikes a target with the force of a door closing between planes.

spell.name: Chainbreaker Word
spell.description: Speaks a stolen Cabal command backward, disrupting control effects and stunning weaker binders.

spell.name: Steady Pulse
spell.description: A practical field charm that steadies breath, slows panic, and closes small wounds before they become large regrets.

spell.name: Purify Blood
spell.description: A clean pulse of reliquary magic that breaks venom in the blood while returning a little strength to the body.

spell.name: Flash
spell.description: A sharp burst of white light that ruins a foe's next attack and gives the caster one precious breath.

spell.name: Battle Focus
spell.description: A fighter cadence that turns breath, stance, and discipline into cleaner strikes.

spell.name: Lock Whisper
spell.description: A rogue charm that lets old tumblers answer in tiny clicks before the pick fully turns.

spell.name: Root Mend
spell.description: A Greenbarrow charm that coaxes stubborn flesh to knit like living bark around a wounded branch.

spell.name: Applewarden Thorns
spell.description: Old orchard thorns rise underfoot, pinning a foe as if the freehold itself has objected.

spell.name: Shieldbreaker Chant
spell.description: A clipped Dawnhammer battle chant that teaches every swing to search for buckles, seams, and fear.

spell.name: Sunforge Guard
spell.description: A Vandarom forge-prayer that sets warm light between the body and the next hard blow.

spell.name: Quarry Renewal
spell.description: A miners' recovery charm built for cracked ribs, falling stone, and the stubborn refusal to stay down.

spell.name: Briar Balm
spell.description: A Fey poultice spell that smells of rain, sap, and promises nobody should make lightly.

spell.name: Foxfire Feint
spell.description: A small green flame misdirects attention just long enough for quiet hands to finish their work.

spell.name: Venom Siphon
spell.description: A marsh rite that pulls poison out through the skin as dark beads of harmless water.

spell.name: Blackwater Grasp
spell.description: Drowned crown-water rises like a cold hand and holds a foe in place while the mud remembers its name.

spell.name: Dune Focus
spell.description: A desert breathing form that makes each strike arrive with the patience of sand burying a road.

spell.name: Prism Bolt
spell.description: A split-light bolt that ricochets through a target's outline before deciding where damage belongs.

spell.name: Breaker Prayer
spell.description: A Tidebound boarding prayer that asks the sea to make the next few blows land like waves against rotten pilings.

spell.name: Thunderclap Rebuke
spell.description: A peak-born rebuke that cracks the air hard enough to steal an enemy's next attack.

spell.name: Black Key Whisper
spell.description: An underworld cipher-spell that convinces locks and pockets they have already been opened.

spell.name: Grave Salve
spell.description: A somber deep-road healing formula that borrows stillness from tomb air and uses it to calm torn flesh.

spell.name: Starfallen Focus
spell.description: A last-citadel oath that turns fear of the dead star into deliberate, punishing force.
